sources: Flare 2.0 练后 专项补强 + Flare2 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，Flare2：背后十指交扣扩胸（站姿））

purpose.zh: 双手背后交扣把手臂向后拉开，拉伸胸口和肩前侧，练完撑地和俯卧撑类动作后放松
purpose.en: Clasp your hands behind your back and draw the arms back. Stretches the chest and fronts of the shoulders after support and push-up work.

text.zh: 手臂伸直往后拉，肩胛夹紧，挺胸
text.en: Arms straight and back, squeeze the shoulder blades, chest up

text.zh: 站直，双手在背后十指交扣，掌心相对。
text.en: Stand tall and interlace your fingers behind your back, palms facing.

text.zh: 伸直手臂，交扣的手往后下方拉离身体。
text.en: Straighten your arms and draw the clasped hands back and away from your body.

text.zh: 肩膀往下沉，头保持中立，上身不往前弯。
text.en: Shoulders down, head neutral, do not bend forward.

commonErrors.en: Bending forward to lift the hands.
Arching the lower back and flaring the ribs.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧刺疼就减小幅度；手扣不上可以握一条毛巾
cautions.en: Reduce the range if the front of the shoulder hurts sharply; hold a towel if your hands do not meet.

flare2.item: Flare2：背后十指交扣扩胸（站姿）
flare2.camera: 右侧偏后（看得到手臂后伸角度、交扣的手和挺胸）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：静态拉伸；草稿保持 20 秒 × 2 次、间隔 10 秒（待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3 2b: fingers interlaced behind the back (V5 interlace hand pose, fingers curled to wrap the other hand), elbows soft at the start, then arms straight with ~40 deg shoulder extension, shoulder blades back and down, chest lifted (5 deg); 8 s loop, hold 4 s, symmetric.

set.zh: 手臂伸直往后拉，肩胛夹紧
set.en: Arms straight and back, squeeze your shoulder blades

set.zh: 肩膀往下沉，上身不往前弯
set.en: Shoulders down, keep your chest tall
